scripts.stop: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$pids = (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.OwningProcess -gt 0 }).OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique; if ($pids) { Stop-Process -Id $pids -Force; Write-Host 'Server stopped' } else { Write-Host 'Server is not running' }"
